subject: Evaluation -> Production: proposed ramp calendar, commits, and commercial milestones
messages:
From: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@apexretail.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@apexretail.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Aligning MAP + evaluation metrics; initial TPM targets

Hi Irene / Lauren —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our leadership liked the latency/cost breakdown you showed. We want to move quickly but need a clear MAP and commercial guardrails so we can get procurement and legal moving. High level asks from our side: 

- A 3-month evaluation window with clear success criteria (latency < 150ms p95 on our sample traffic, 95% quality pass rate on our acceptance prompt set).
- A ramp to production over 4 months after evaluation with monthly TPM commitments (want a clear monthly calendar).
- Pricing tiers and a discount schedule tied to committed monthly TPM; we need to understand overage billing and credit mechanics.
- A draft SOW or playbook we can circulate to procurement/legal.

Can you propose a MAP with milestone dates, the commit ladder (TPM per month), and the commercial levers (discount triggers, credits for missed SLOs)? I'm looping in procurement (procure@apexretail.com) — Maria from legal/procurement will be the main reviewer.

Attached is our annotated RFP with a few callouts.

Next step for us is to present your proposed MAP to the steering committee on Monday 11/30.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Jenkins
Director, Data Products | Apex Retail

Attachment: Apex_RFP_annotated.pdf (PDF, 78KB)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@apexretail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procure@apexretail.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Aligning MAP + evaluation metrics; initial TPM targets

Hi Sam —

Appreciate the clear asks and attaching this. Below is a concise MAP draft we can present to your steering committee Monday; happy to adjust the dates if you need shorter timelines.

Proposed MAP (high level)
- Evaluation (weeks 0–12): Nov 24 — Feb 16
  - Milestone E1 (week 2): initial integration & baseline test (sample traffic ingest)
  - Milestone E2 (week 6): latency & throughput validation; KV/prefix cache configured
  - Milestone E3 (week 12): acceptance run on 5k prompt set; quality pass threshold >= 95%

- Ramp (months 1–4 post-eval): Feb 17 — Jun 16
  - Month 1 ramp: 10M TPM commit
  - Month 2 ramp: 30M TPM commit
  - Month 3 ramp: 60M TPM commit
  - Month 4 steady-state target: 120M TPM commit

Commercial levers (summary)
- Pricing tiers: base price per token with step discounts at each committed band (10M / 30M / 60M / 120M).
- Ramp credits: 10% credit on overage during first two ramp months if p95 latency > 180ms for more than 1% of requests and caused by our runtime (we'll provide traces).
- Early-commit discount: additional 5% if you sign a 12-month committed contract at the start of Month 2.
- Overage: billed at 1.25x the committed unit price unless a temporary burst policy is agreed (we can configure a 10% buffer).

Deliverables / artifacts
- Draft SOW (we'll attach) with acceptance criteria, data handling, and security checklist.
- Weekly checkpoint reports during evaluation with token/latency breakdowns.

Attachments included for internal review: RDW-draft-SOW-nov2026.docx, pricing-ramp-model-apex.xlsx

If that aligns, Lauren will follow up with the commercial terms and a version of the pricing workbook that includes your expected traffic shape.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: RDW-draft-SOW-nov2026.docx, pricing-ramp-model-apex.xlsx

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@apexretail.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procure@apexretail.com, Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@apexretail.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Aligning MAP + evaluation metrics; initial TPM targets

Sam / Maria —

Thank you. We reviewed internal pricing and can confirm the commercial outline below. Key points and concessions we've cleared for this MAP: 

Commercial outline (summary)- Evaluation phase: credits equal to 100% of tokens used during evaluation capped at 5M tokens as an evaluation credit (applies to first invoice post-evaluation).
- Ramp commit ladder & list price per token (net after tiered discounts applied in workbook):
  - 10M TPM: list price (no additional volume discount)
  - 30M TPM: 12% discount off list
  - 60M TPM: 18% discount off list
  - 120M TPM: 25% discount off list
- SLA credit trigger: if monthly uptime < 99.5% or p95 latency > 200ms driven by Redwood, automatic 5% invoice credit for that month. (We will define diagnostic ownership in the SOW.)
- Billing / payment terms: Net 45 by default; we can consider Net 30 if PO is received and a 12-month commit is signed at start of Month 2.

Open items we need from Apex to finalize the commercial:
1) Confirmation of expected traffic shape (token distribution by request length) — we used the sample you shared but want the 90th percentile sizes.
2) Procurement timeline / PO date target (you mentioned a steering committee on 11/30).
3) Any required vendor contract addenda (security/data residency).

Next steps: I've attached a redlined pricing workbook and a clean SOW. Marissa, can you start the contract handoff with Legal Ops and add the credit language? Marissa: please include a clause that allows a burst buffer of up to 10% for the first 90 days post-ramp without overage charges.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: pricing-ramp-model-apex.xlsx (updated), RDW-draft-SOW-nov2026.docx (clean)

From: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@apexretail.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@apexretail.com>, procure@apexretail.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Aligning MAP + evaluation metrics; initial TPM targets

Irene / Lauren —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clarity. The steering committee liked the MAP and the ramp cadence. A few clarifications before we circulate to procurement/legal for PO: 

1) Overage mechanics: confirm that overage billed at 1.25x is only for sustained over-usage beyond the 10% buffer after the 4th ramp month (i.e., after steady-state)? We need an interim policy for bursts during the ramp months that avoids surprise invoices.

2) Evaluation credit: can the evaluation credit be applied pro-rata if we convert to a shorter 6-month commit instead of 12 months? Our CFO prefers a shorter term but with higher near-term commit.

3) Payment term: our procurement team prefers Net 30. We can agree to a 12-month commit starting Month 2 if Redwood can move to Net 30 on the invoice schedule. Is there flexibility on both sides?

If you confirm these points I will ask Maria to start the redline process. Also, we can sign the SOW subject to legal review and provide tentative PO timing (targeting PO by 12/10).

Best,
Sam
